records.scope: current qualified Core objects; separate measurement binary, no attention candidate; serial versus E4_R32, Q4 width64 both arms

limitations: Fixed existing Gemma4 GGUF and captured SSA graph; one predefined attention candidate versus incumbent; no arbitrary new Python model capture.
Only 3 fixtures x32 full-logit steps and paired warm-Hello31-decode workload qualified.
Attention logits are tolerance-equivalent, not bit-identical. Full relative error bound is1e-4; worst observed7.529184222e-5.
Experiment record is metadata/evidence; no saved Metal binary, public serving installer or default change.
Exact binary identity invalidates record on rebuild; verification always reruns qualification.
Timing records are separate rounds; pair-median reduction differs from reduction of wall medians. No Ollama/MLX or cross-machine comparison.
Timed runs check generated IDs and counters; all-logit finite/error gates occur before timing, not on every timed call.
Process-wide diagnostic counters support this sequential experiment, not concurrent serving qualification.
Digest provides content integrity, not authenticity. Five negative cases are not an exhaustive validator security proof.
